subject: Reading in existing map - assigning a class

messages.author: b7656b583b2ec025
messages.subject: Reading in existing map - assigning a class
parts:
Hi,

I created a map a while ago, but I'd actually like to revise it and make some changes.
When I made it I downloaded as a .csv which I have but no longer the map in my R

I'd like to upload this csv to then use as my base instead of going through making the map from scratch as I have assigned chromosome names and ordered the groups. 

I used this function:
dat1 <- read.cross("csv", dir="[location]", file="[filename]")

which then using:
plot.map(dat1)
and
summary.map(dat1)
It looks like my genetic map as before. However there is no class. This population is a dh. How do I add the class to it. And then will it be a map which I can then use the various functions on?

Cheers.

messages.author: b7656b583b2ec025
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Reading in existing map - assigning a class
parts:
Hi Karl, 

thanks for getting back to me.

When I run:
>summary(dat1)
At the top, the population is called "F2 intercross", I'd like it to be a "DH". So it does have a class, just not the one I want.
If I try reading it in
>dat1 <- read.cross("csv", dir="[location]", file="[filename]",pop.type= "DH")
then I get the error:
Error in read.table(file, sep = ",", na.strings = na.strings, colClasses = "character",  : 
  unused argument (pop.type = "DH")

Trying to use the pullCross function:
>test <- pullCross(dat1, type = "missing", pars = list(miss.thresh =0.05))
then I get the error:
Error in pullCross(dat1, type = "missing", pars = list(miss.thresh = 0.05)) : 
  Pulling of markers is not supported for this population type, see ?pullCross.

I looked through the documentation for pullCross and couldn't see the issue I appear to be having.

Cheers

messages.author: b7656b583b2ec025
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Reading in existing map - assigning a class
parts:
Hi Karl,

I think I have solved the issue. I have now read my map in using:

testy <- read.cross("csv",, "[myfile.csv]", genotypes=c("A","B"), estimate.map = F)                   
class(testy)[1]<-"dh"

A bit more reading and I wouldn't have wasted your time. Hopefully someone else will find this useful.
Cheers.

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Reading in existing map - assigning a class
parts:
I'm glad you figured it out; don't worry about wasting my time.

You can also use crosstype="dh" in the call to read.cross:

   testy <- read.cross("csv",, "[myfile.csv]", genotypes=c("A","B"), estimate.map = F, crosstype="dh")

karl

A bit more reading and I wouldn't have wasted your time. Hopefully someone else will find this useful.
